nodes.description: IERC20 token address held by FireVault; read in TheBigBurn and written in setFIREAddress.
Constant uint timestamp 1608854400 (25 Dec 2020) used to gate TheBigBurn.
Private owner address inherited from Ownable; compared in onlyOwner and updated in ownership functions.
External function that requires block.timestamp >= TheBigBurnTime and burns the vault's FIRE balance.
Owner-only function that sets the FIRE token address exactly once.
Public view returning the current _owner address.
Owner-only function that sets _owner to address(0).
Owner-only function that sets _owner to newOwner after a non-zero check.
Internal view returning msg.sender; used by Ownable authorization.
Ownable constructor that stores the deployer as _owner.
Modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender(); access-control gate for privileged functions.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership comparison in onlyOwner.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared against TheBigBurnTime in TheBigBurn.
External call into the FIRE token contract to irreversibly burn the vault balance.
External call reading the FIRE balance of the vault; result is passed to the burn call.
State write setting _owner to address(0), permanently disabling owner-only functions.
State write assigning the owner-supplied address into FIRE, the token that will be burned.
IERC20 address parameter of setFIREAddress, written into the FIRE state variable.
Address parameter of transferOwnership, written into the _owner state variable.
Local variable in the constructor caching _msgSender() before writing _owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender flows into the onlyOwner comparison determining whether the caller is authorized.
_owner is read in the onlyOwner modifier to validate the caller identity.
setFIREAddress is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier, restricting who can set the token address.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner so only the current owner can renounce.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner so only the current owner can transfer ownership.
block.timestamp is used inside TheBigBurn to authorize execution timing (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is compared against the constant TheBigBurnTime, making the gate miner-influenceable.
TheBigBurnTime constant is read in the require condition of TheBigBurn.
The FIRE state variable is read in TheBigBurn to check it is set.
TheBigBurn invokes the external burnMyTokensFOREVER call on the FIRE token.
FIRE is the target contract of the external burnMyTokensFOREVER call.
TheBigBurn reaches the external balanceOf read of the vault's token balance.
FIRE is the contract queried by balanceOf(address(this)).
The balance returned by balanceOf is passed as the amount burned by burnMyTokensFOREVER.
setFIREAddress writes the FIRE state variable.
setFIREAddress performs the FIRE address state write.
The _addr parameter is the value assigned to the FIRE state variable.
The FIRE address write updates the FIRE state variable.
renounceOwnership performs the _owner = address(0) state write.
The renounce write clears the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into the _owner state variable.
The newOwner parameter is stored into _owner.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to its callers.
The constructor calls _msgSender() to obtain the deployer address.
The value returned by _msgSender is assigned to the local variable msgSender.
The local msgSender is written into the _owner state variable during construction.
owner() returns the current _owner state variable.
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter in its zero-address check.
The constructor initializes the _owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The _addr parameter only exists to feed the FIRE state write inside setFIREAddress, so it can be normalized into that core function.
The newOwner parameter only exists to be validated and stored in transferOwnership, so it can be normalized into that core function.
The msgSender local is a temporary cache of _msgSender() used only to seed _owner in the constructor, so it can be normalized into the constructor.
